description: Fuzzy-search skills by free-text query against name, description, tags, principles, phrases, and tactic scripts. Use this DURING a call when you need a playbook for the situation you just hit ("the rep is asking for a settlement number — what do I do?"). Returns ranked summaries; load the top match with `skill_load`.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. "rep wants me to commit to payment" or "restaurant fully booked".

name: skill_search
